rows.text: I'm not trying to freeze a heat setting. I need to stop the stove starting with a single accidental touch.
I feed signed forms through once. I need the handwritten notes on the back captured too.
Can I wipe the controls with the burner running without changing the timer or switching zones?
There's no storage slot for the spare nibs. Mine slide out of the box.
灶已经关了，小孩一碰就亮，想把初次启动锁住。
The sorting is fine. I need the duplex feeder to stop dropping the reverse side of the thin sheets.
批量扫描时想直接顺序输出正反面，几十页逐张翻太费劲了。
机器把每张白纸都加进文件里，我得逐页删。想保留有手写批注的页。
A visitor leaned against the off cooktop and switched it on. Can it require a long press or another action first?
Duplex works. Can it leave out genuinely empty backs without losing a faint note or stamp?
离开厨房以后想让它维持关着，别让清洁时误按一次就加热。
关机放着时猫踩一下别把灶打开，开火要有人主动解锁才行。
煮粥时一滴水落到面板上就把档位改了，想有个烹饪中的锁定。
炖汤的时候希望锁住操作键，锅继续煮，小孩摸到也别把火力调掉。
双面扫描不成问题，想让成品少些白页，有章的反面一定要留下。
I don't need a second file. Put the writing on each back side immediately after its front page.
保温杯刻度太浅，室外看不出还剩多少水。
自动处理我都开了，偶尔有一页不见了，记不得原来那面有没有字。
The child lock keeps the cooktop off, which is fine. I need a way to protect the settings after I start cooking.
Our counter processes receipt packets with blank divider sheets. I want the resulting PDF to exclude those blanks.
一叠收据背面有签字，想两面一起扫，不用手翻再排序。
清洁台面时灶具本来没开，一碰就启动，这个动作能多一步确认吗？
扫描成PDF之前能不能把纸张反面的内容也收进去？现在每次少一半。
I wish the manufacturer's label were on the underside rather than the front.
The reverse side is often blank. A real mark should remain, but I don't want to remove all the empty images myself.
Only every other page appears after I scan folded instructions. Please grab front and back in the same pass.
I don't know if it started or just lit up. It was my first time trying the buttons.
电源线收纳位置太靠外，入柜的时候会顶住门。
一边炒菜一边擦台面总会碰到触控键，想保留原火力别乱变。
I need the cooktop to keep heating while the panel is locked, so a wet cloth can't turn it down.
扫描合同要留有字的背页，全白页希望自动丢掉，不然交上去多几十张。
I only need a lock when the unit is idle so a hand brushing the panel can't fire up a burner.
有时锁住太死，有时又容易误碰，做饭前后两种情况我都碰到过。
The pages after lunch came out odd. I changed the paper before I noticed so I don't know which bit failed.
能识别完全空白那一面再跳过吗？背面有一点内容的照样保留。
I brush the controls while stirring and the heat jumps. Let me lock the current level while the pan is on.
